column1: # Issue #261 — the `/detected_labels` half of the registered cardinality
# divergence: PulsusDB reports the EXACT distinct-value count
# (`uniqExact(val)`, crates/pulsus-read/src/logql/sql.rs:163-178); the
# reference reports a p14 HyperLogLog estimate
# (`newParsedLabels` -> `hyperloglog.New()`, pkg/querier/querier.go:942-947
# @ grafana/loki v3.7.4 = b318f2829f0ae2094ab3a1e90780450e9e4b03be).
# THE AGREEMENT THRESHOLD IS A PROPERTY OF THE VALUE STRINGS, NOT OF N.
# Three families measured at the SAME n = 7708 give three different
# reference answers below, and a fourth family diverges at 4533. No row
# here may be read as a bound on any other family.
# Capture conditions (2026-08-08):
#  - container: docker.io/grafana/loki:3.7.4, digest
#    sha256:87f0a067673756a3cede1bcbf0c74875f7df9b09fddb53e399d0c576f756cfcc,
#    single binary, filesystem store, tsdb/v13; limits_config overrides
#    max_global_streams_per_user: 0, max_streams_per_user: 0,
#    discover_log_levels: false, split_queries_by_interval: 0.
#    ONE stream per distinct value, ONE entry each, all at the same
#    timestamp; scoped by a per-fixture `app` label. Request
#    `GET /loki/api/v1/detected_labels?query={app="<fixture>"}&start&end`
#    over a 2 h window. 3 reps per fixture, identical answers.
#  - library: the vendored github.com/axiomhq/hyperloglog v0.2.6 copied out
#    of that same Loki checkout, driven as the querier drives it
#    (`New()`, `Insert([]byte(v))`, `Estimate()`), FRESH SKETCH PER N.
#    Validated first against the already-committed #244 artifact
#    (golden/detected_cardinality/reference_divergence.tsv), which it
#    reproduces exactly. Insertion order (numeric vs lexicographic) does
#    not move any value in this file.
# LAST-AGREEING WITNESSES (container, same conditions) — deliberately NOT
# rows, because a row that agrees discriminates nothing:
# columns: family <TAB> n_distinct <TAB> reference_value <TAB> pulsus_exact <TAB> observed_by <TAB> ledger_id <TAB> note
